name: vivieen-companion
author: Vivieen contributors
description: Privacy-conscious, provider-agnostic talking avatar for Apple Silicon Macs

scripts.build:native: npm run build:audio-tap && npm run build:cutout && npm run build:key-tap
scripts.test: .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v && node qa/track_qa.js && node qa/enconvo_monitor_qa.js && node qa/enconvo_replay_qa.js && node qa/pet_window_bounds_qa.js
scripts.check:syntax: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/bubble-preload.cjs && node --check electron/appearance-preload.cjs && node --check electron/enconvo-audio-monitor.cjs && node --check electron/pet-window-bounds.cjs && node --check qa/life_probe.js && node --check qa/track_qa.js && node --check qa/enconvo_monitor_qa.js && node --check qa/pet_window_bounds_qa.js && node scripts/check-inline-scripts.mjs && .venv/bin/python -m py_compile server/app.py server/providers.py server/align.py server/visemes.py studio/build.py studio/compose.py studio/face.py studio/blink.py studio/rig.py studio/anatomy.py studio/export.py studio/cutout.py studio/body.py studio/motion.py studio/library.py studio/wardrobe.py studio/prep.py scripts/generate-pet-motion.py tests/test_providers.py tests/test_rig.py tests/test_pet_mode.py tests/test_motion_transactions.py tests/test_set_library.py tests/test_gait_cycle.py tests/test_limb_reactions.py studio/limbs.py tests/test_avatar_transfer.py tests/test_wardrobe_prompt.py tests/test_prep_crown.py tests/test_studio_shell.py scripts/public-release-audit.py
scripts.check:avatar: node qa/life_probe.js . check && .venv/bin/python -W ignore qa/blink_lash_qa.py && .venv/bin/python -W ignore qa/mouth_motion_qa.py
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:native && npm test && npm run check:privacy
scripts.pack: npm run build:native && npm run stage:python && npm run stage:ffmpeg && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:native && npm run stage:python && npm run stage:ffmpeg && electron-builder --mac dmg

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vivieen uses the microphone only while you hold the talk button.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Vivieen listens only to EnConvo audio while Follow EnConvo is enabled, so the avatar can move with the voice.
